Marvel’s Wolverine | Digital Deluxe Edition Trailer
Unleash your full potential with the Marvel’s Wolverine Digital Deluxe Edition. Look sharp with five exclusive suits and five exclusive claws, including signature looks from iconic Wolverine comics and new original collaborations with Marvel artists.   

The Marvel’s Wolverine Digital Deluxe Edition includes:

Marvel’s Wolverine Digital Game

All Pre-Order Bonuses

5 Exclusive Suits

- Incredible
- Savage – Original Design by Adam Kubert
- Age of Apocalypse
- Night Hunt – Original Design by Iban Coello
- New Leather

5 Exclusive Claws

- Smooth-Edged Claws
- Hollow Blade Claws
- Thick Claws
- Serrated Spine Claws
- Tapered Claws

3 Additional Technique Points

Marvel’s Wolverine launches September 15, 2026, on PlayStation 5 consoles. Pre-order and wishlist now on the PlayStation Store. 

For more information, visit https://www.playstation.com/en-us/games/marvels-wolverine/
